core.title: 16 Inch Cross Handles, Pair, First Impressions CROSS-16

text.description_html:
First Impressions Cross Door Handles

These large 16" cross door handles are sold as a set of two (2). For use on double doors (french doors), each cross door pull is installed on one door. Two tone finish - The background section of the handle is a textured dark bronze color and the foreground section is satin silver.

These cross door handles are hand made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions. Long lasting powder coated finish to with stand abuse and harsh environments.

Specifications of the First Impressions Cross Door Handles:

  • Total Height: 16"
  • Total Width (both sections combined): 7-3/16"
  • Max Thickness: 1-1/8"
  • Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 2-5/8"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 9-1/2" Center to Center (CTC)
  • Standoffs: 4 Vertical, 2 Horizontal per pair
  • Material: Non Rusting Aluminum
  • Finish: Textured Dark Bronze/ Satin Silver

Note: This cross door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Finishes. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts through the door) for a 1-3/4" thick door.

*Sold as a Pair (2 cross sections - as pictured).
